=============================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.bbtpy.util.centerlines_from_eicab

.. py:function:: _grids_match(a_shape: tuple[int, Ellipsis], b_shape: tuple[int, Ellipsis]) -> bool

   True when the first three dimensions of two volumes match.


.. py:function:: build_centerlines_from_eicab(eicab_mask_path: pathlib.Path, vwi_bb_ref_path: pathlib.Path, out_dir: pathlib.Path, *, transform_mat: pathlib.Path | None = None, min_points: int = 5, skip_existing: bool = False, eicab_mask_info: nvitk.pipes.bbtpy.util.eicab_masks.EicabMaskResolution | None = None) -> CenterlineArtifacts

   Relabel eICAB labels, warp into vwi_bb grid if needed, compute centerlines in BB space.
